name: near-chunk-validation-d1

restrictions.text: protocol_version = 86 (nearcore 2.13.4), mainnet runtime parameters RuntimeConfigStore::new(None).get_config(86)
every block of the claim's chain segment is in epoch_id; one epoch record; no epoch start in the segment
the epoch's shard layout is ShardLayout V2 or V3 with 1..=64 shards
block headers V6; chunk header inners V4/V5
no validator-account update and no dynamic-resharding split check for any applied block
the last new chunk of the shard is not the genesis chunk
the chain segment has at most 32 blocks
the shard's congestion info in the last-chunk block has zero delayed gas, buffered gas and receipt bytes
every transaction in transactions and new_transactions: V0, or V1 with a plain nonce; exactly one Transfer action; ED25519 public key and ED25519 signature
every signer account read by process_transactions is AccountV1
no contract code accompanies the witness
state witness <= 8 MiB and the main transition's base_state <= 3,000,000 bytes
every receipt in every source_receipt_proofs entry (incl. overridden duplicate keys) has the D0 receipt shape
every applied receipt (incoming or local): ReceiptEnum::Action, one Transfer action, no data dependencies, ED25519/SECP256K1 signer key, named receiver
a gas refund (system predecessor, signer = receiver) finds no access key or a FullAccess key
every applied receipt (incoming or local) succeeds (receiver exists as AccountV1, no overflow, storage stake covered)
no local or incoming receipt is delayed by the compute limit (transactions' gas counts)
delayed-receipt queue, outgoing buffers and promise-yield queue are empty in the pre-state
every transaction receipt and generated receipt is forwarded (never buffered)
applied (incoming and local) receipt ids are pairwise distinct
